abstract: StrucMind provides two PyMOL plugins for comparing protein contact maps and examining the interactions around a bound ligand. A contact seen in only one structure can reflect a difference in packing or a gap in the coordinates needed for comparison. Contact Maps aligns corresponding residues, identifies retained, gained and lost contacts, and records why a comparison remains unresolved. Structure Analysis measures direct ligand-protein contacts, traces paths through individual water molecules, and characterizes aromatic packing and pocket geometry. Users can select a contact or a water-mediated path to inspect the atoms in PyMOL. Exported atom identities, distances and coordinate coverage let a colleague retrace the assignment. Keywords. Molecular recognition, Noncovalent interactions, Protein contact maps, PyMOL, Water bridges.
